decisions.server108: Profile and reduce per-document analysis cost; keep the original fixture and the 180 s budget; cached reuse only for open warm documents. The Salsa-published fixture change (measured 368-377 s) is not applied.
decisions.source_order_entry_script: Assume a sourced file is not also an entry script, except files with a `#!` line or that read argv0 (those prove nothing). Stated in the contract (SourceOrderPremises UnlessMarked).
decisions.source_order_working_directory: Anchored paths only: an absolute path or [file join [file dirname [info script]] ...] proves order; a relative literal `source` proves nothing. The both_tiers loader fixture is written in the anchored form.
